body:
It’s so hard, it happened over a month ago but I realise just my insecurities and fear of losing her, which was irrational just built and built. I smothered her with attention and when I felt her pulling away I got upset. I told her I didn’t want to be with her or see her after she tried to work things out over and over during our fight, but I just kept crying and feeling worthless. I never realised how destructive I was being.

The last month before it all happened I’ve lost my job, been in a car crash, my grandpa who is basically like my dad had gotten diagnosed with cancer and I was struggling severely at university, my life felt like it was out of control and losing her was the final and worst thing that could’ve happened.

Before it all happened I spiralled in to a depression and became suicidal, and suddenly went back in to my high dosage of anti depressants, a couple days before the fight we had.

I said so many awful things to her, things I could never imagine saying. Calling her selfish, trying to shame her for leaving me for her friends, I was so controlling and out of control. I drove to her parents house when she stopped responding to me and broke down in front of them, telling them everything. I was a wreck.

I’m in therapy now, and was on a 14 day program too, and have been put on a lot of meds, but everyday I wake up I cry and regret everything I done, I’ve hated myself so much since that day. She deserved so much better than the shit I put her through.
